# the library's part of the program, in the order the linker took its modules
# (codebreaker exact library): where each module's code (or data) stands in the program.
SLIBFP:fltused   # (its bytes tell nothing: it took fakcvt, for __fassign, which no other module names)
amalloc          # code 03bf8 (333 bytes)  data 1520
fopen            # code 03d45 (38 bytes)
_filbuf          # code 03d6b (187 bytes)

_file            # data 167c
atof             # code 040f0 (65 bytes)
ungetc           # code 04131 (86 bytes)
atoi             # code 04187 (3 bytes)  (by _atoi, which SYMBOLS names)
atol             # code 04187  (the same bytes as atoi)
almul            # code 0418a (32 bytes)
aulmul           # code 0418a  (the same bytes as almul)
perror           # code 041aa (122 bytes)  data 1746
fwrite           # code 04224 (318 bytes)
printf           # code 04362 (54 bytes)

closeall         # code 0482c  (the same bytes as flushall)
flushall         # code 0482c (52 bytes)  (of the same bytes, the one whose calls go where their names are)
_freebuf         # code 04860 (50 bytes)
